rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for things occupying the same space or for time periods overlapping.

example.english: The times of the two meetings coincide.
example.traditional: 兩個會議嘅時間重疊咗。
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 wui6 ji5 ge3 si4 gaan3 cung4 dip6 zo2

rows.note: Use this when two events or dates happen to line up at the same time, especially by chance.

example.traditional: 我哋兩個嘅假期撞啱咗喎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 gaa3 kei4 zong6 ngaam1 zo2 wo3

rows.note: Use this when opinions, accounts, or other things correspond or agree with each other.

example.english: The data in the two reports coincide with the actual situation.
example.traditional: 兩份報告嘅數據同實際情況吻合。
example.jyutping: loeng5 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 tung4 sat6 zai3 cing4 fong3 man5 hap6
